thornscouts.title: Thornscouts
thornscouts.lore: STORY A field note The four Thornscouts mark safe crossings with tiny cuts in their light blades. Pale leaf masks turn their faces into a blur among the fern paths.

forgeguard.title: Forgeguard
forgeguard.lore: STORY A field note Five Forgeguard keep the river workshops supplied with hammers and axes. Their copper aprons darken at the seams, but each hammer tap keeps the old bridge pins true.
